The photo render's path tracer (vendor/three/examples/jsm/gpu-pathtracer/pathtracer.js) is made from
three-gpu-pathtracer (https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-gpu-pathtracer, branch main, 31 Oct 2026) and
three-mesh-bvh (https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh, branch master, 31 Oct 2026), both by Garrett Johnson,
published under the MIT License:

How it was made (tools/pathtracer-build.md): the *.generated.js files of three-mesh-bvh from its templates
(tools/pathtracer-generate.py), then one module with esbuild (three stays outside; the WebGPU parts are not used):
  esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --external:three --alias:three-mesh-bvh=<three-mesh-bvh>/src/index.js
          --alias:three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/Pass.js=vendor/three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/Pass.js
  entry.js: export { WebGLPathTracer } from '<three-gpu-pathtracer>/src/core/WebGLPathTracer.js';
            export { GradientEquirectTexture } from '<three-gpu-pathtracer>/src/textures/GradientEquirectTexture.js';
